{"baseRefName":"develop","body":"# Description

Implements the wishlist auth gate per SFCC-742 — a `ZimmWishlistAuthDrawer` organism that
intercepts any wishlist trigger and, when the customer is not logged in, opens a Zimmermann-branded
auth drawer instead. Passwordless email (OTP) and optional Apple/Google social IDPs are supported.
When already registered, the original `onAuthSuccess` callback fires immediately with no drawer
open. All SDK and auth logic lives in `useWishlistAuthDrawer` — the organism is purely
presentational.

Six points worth surfacing before review:

- **Drop-in replacement for `withRegistration`.** `ZimmWishlistAuthDrawer` wraps a single trigger
  element (any `ReactElement`) and replaces its `onClick` via `React.cloneElement`. Its public API
  is just `onAuthSuccess` + `children` — no SFCC internals leak to the caller.
- **`triggerRef` uses `e.currentTarget`, not `document.activeElement` or `cloneElement` ref
  forwarding.** `cloneElement` ref forwarding requires the child to use `forwardRef` — not
  guaranteed for all consumers. `e.currentTarget` is always the element the handler is attached to,
  reliable across mouse and keyboard. The ref is passed to `ZimmDrawer`'s `finalFocusRef` so focus
  returns to the trigger on close (WCAG 2.4.3 / AC10).
- **`initialFocusRef` wired through `ZimmDrawer` → Chakra's `Drawer`.** `ZimmDrawerBaseProps` gains
  an `initialFocusRef` prop so focus lands on the email input (not the close button) when the
  drawer opens, instead of defaulting to Chakra's FocusLock first-focusable. `ZimmDrawer` was the
  only place this was missing — no base template file needed a copy-first override.
- **`ErrorFallback` sits above `ZimmAuthDrawerContent` in `ZimmWishlistAuthDrawer`, not inside it.**
  A boundary inside a component cannot catch that component's own render errors (hooks, early
  function-body code). Moving it one level up means any crash in `ZimmAuthDrawerContent` —
  including a `useMultiStyleConfig` throw on a misconfigured recipe — is contained to the drawer
  content rather than propagating to the app-level boundary and crashing the page. The fallback
  currently returns `null` (blank drawer content), preserving the drawer chrome (title, close
  button) — the Zimmermann-designed error state is a pending requirement, commented in-file as a
  TODO.
- **Social IDP flows (Apple/Google) trigger a full browser redirect.** `onAuthSuccess` is not
  called for those paths — the user lands back already logged in and the wishlist action must be
  re-triggered. This is consistent with SFCC's own `withRegistration` behaviour.
- **Contentful seed script is safe to re-run.** `scripts/contentful/seedLoginDrawerUiCopy.mjs`
  creates 8 `uiCopy` entries for the login drawer microcopy, skipping any key that already exists.
  It paginates correctly (1,000-entry chunks) before building the duplicate-check set. Run with
  `node scripts/contentful/seedLoginDrawerUiCopy.mjs --target dev` after this PR merges.

# Linked

- Ticket: **SFCC-742** (Wishlist — Login Panel Content)
- Sprint: SFCC — Sprint 7

# Squad ownership

- [x] Squad A (common UI, homepage, navigation, regional storefront, PDP, PLP, cart, checkout, order, payments, returns)
- [ ] Squad B (search & recommendations, promotions, account, store locator, Zimmerse, SEO & analytics)
- [x] Cross-squad — `ui-kits/` atoms and organisms are owned by both squads; both leads notified

# Types of Changes

- [x] **New feature** (non-breaking change that adds functionality)

# Changes

- `components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmWishlistAuthDrawer/index.tsx` — organism shell; wraps
  trigger, drives `ZimmDrawer` + `ZimmAuthDrawerContent` + `OtpAuth` + SFCC `AuthModal`
- `hooks/useWishlistAuthDrawer.ts` — all SDK integration (passwordless, IDP, OTP, register modal),
  focus-ref capture, and auth-success side-effect. `DRAWER_ANIMATION_DELAY_MS` constant guards
  the two `setTimeout` calls from drifting independently
- `components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmAuthDrawerContent/index.tsx` — branded login view; composes
  `EmailForm`, `SocialButtons`, `CreateAccount`. Purely presentational — no hooks, no SDK calls
- `components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmAuthDrawerContent/emailForm.tsx` — email input + send-code CTA
- `components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmAuthDrawerContent/socialButtons.tsx` — Apple/Google IDP buttons;
  conditionally rendered per `loginConfig.social`
- `components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmAuthDrawerContent/createAccount.tsx` — "New to Zimmermann?"
  section with create-account CTA
- `components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmAuthDrawerContent/errorFallback.tsx` — React error boundary
  class component; catches all render errors from `ZimmAuthDrawerContent` and its subtree; returns
  `null` (blank) pending Zimmermann error-state design
- `components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmAuthDrawerContent/zimmAuthDrawerContent.css.ts` — co-located
  Chakra recipe; registered in `theme/components/index.ts`
- `components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmFormInput/` — box-border input atom per Figma node 1250:58855;
  visually-hidden label for a11y; `ZimmFormInput` recipe co-located
- `components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmSocialButton/` — social sign-in button atom; `social` variant
  wired in `zimmButton.css.ts`; icon slot accepts any `ReactElement`
- `components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmDrawer/index.tsx` — gains `initialFocusRef` prop; wired to
  Chakra's `Drawer` primitive. No API-breaking change to existing callers
- `components/product-tile/index.tsx` — `handleFavouriteToggle` wraps `onFavouriteToggle` in
  `try/finally` so `isFavouriteLoading.current` always resets even when the toggle throws
- `scripts/contentful/seedLoginDrawerUiCopy.mjs` — one-off seed for 8 `uiCopy` entries; paginated
  duplicate check; idempotent

- `theme/components/index.ts` — registers `ZimmAuthDrawerContent` recipe
- `translations/en.json` — adds keys for 8 new `uiCopy` entries

# How to test-drive this PR

- `npm run env -- dev && npm start` → any PDP. Click a wishlist heart — if not logged in, the
  Zimmermann auth drawer slides in from the right with the email form and (if enabled) social
  sign-in buttons. If already logged in, the item is added directly
- Enter an email and click **Send code** — OTP modal opens after the drawer exits
- Complete OTP — wishlist action fires via `onAuthSuccess`
- Click **Create an account** — SFCC registration modal opens
- Close the drawer — focus returns to the wishlist trigger (keyboard Tab order restored)
- `npm run storybook` → `Commerce/ZimmWishlistAuthDrawer`, `Commerce/ZimmAuthDrawerContent`,
  `Elements/ZimmFormInput`, `Elements/ZimmSocialButton`

> **No Tier 1 file is modified by this PR.**

> ⚠️ **Tier 2** — `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` (UI-Designer-owned — registration
> entry only, no design values). `config/dev.js` is Tier 1 Runtime & Integration Config; the
> change enables passwordless and social login feature flags for the dev environment only —
> no production config is touched. `overrides/app/components/product-tile/` is Tier 2 Shared
> Product Components (Squad B owner — notified).

# Testing

- [x] `npx tsc --noEmit` — clean
- [x] `npm run test` (Vitest) — 705 passed / 48 files
- [x] Storybook stories added for all four new components with `play` functions:
  `ZimmWishlistAuthDrawer` (clicks trigger, asserts drawer opens via `within(document.body)`);
  `ZimmAuthDrawerContent` (types into email input via stateful wrapper)
- [x] Local CodeRabbit (`coderabbit review --light --base develop`) — run; 10 findings applied
  before commit (paginated Contentful fetch, focus-return ref, try/finally on favourite toggle,
  URL encoding, `initialFocusRef`, portal-aware `play` function, Storybook import corrections,
  error fallback message, `onAuthSuccess` mock comment)
- [x] `npm run audit:tokens` — no new violations introduced. Pre-existing 14 are unchanged
  from `develop`
- **Not verified: OTP and social IDP flows end-to-end.** Passwordless and Apple/Google IDP
  require a live SFCC org with the feature flags enabled — verifiable on the dev/sit tier after
  the seed script runs. OTP modal is SFCC's own `OtpAuth` component, unchanged here
- **N/A: Playwright.** No auth-gate spec exists; writing one is gated on Lead QA signing off a
  Gherkin `.feature` first, per the three-stage workflow

# Accessibility

Minimum bar **WCAG 2.2 AA**.

- [x] `initialFocusRef` — focus lands on the email input when the drawer opens, not on the
  close button (WCAG 2.4.3 Focus Order)
- [x] `finalFocusRef` — focus returns to the wishlist trigger on drawer close, restoring Tab
  order (WCAG 2.4.3 / AC10)
- [x] `ZimmFormInput` label is visually hidden but associated with the input for screen readers
- [x] `IconButton` in the story carries `aria-label="Wishlist"` — no visible text, so the label
  is the only thing a screen reader can announce
- [x] `ErrorFallback`'s `componentDidCatch` logs to `console.error` — the fallback `null` return
  means no visible error UI, which is intentional pending the Zimmermann-designed error state
- [ ] **Not tested with a screen reader.** The drawer open/close focus management is proven via
  refs and unit tests; actual AT vocalisation of the email input on open is unverified

# Localisation

- [x] All copy is driven by Contentful `uiCopy` entries via `useUiCopy()` with hardcoded
  `defaultMessage` fallbacks. No string is hardcoded in component JSX
- [x] Seed script creates 8 entries; `translations/en.json` adds the matching keys.
  Run `node scripts/contentful/seedLoginDrawerUiCopy.mjs --target dev` after merge

# Known gaps and follow-ups

- **`ErrorFallback` returns `null`** — the drawer opens blank on a render error. A
  Zimmermann-designed error state (copy, layout) is a pending requirement; the placeholder
  message is commented in `errorFallback.tsx` as a TODO
- **Social IDP (Apple/Google) does not call `onAuthSuccess`** — the user lands back already
  logged in after the redirect. The wishlist action must be re-triggered. Consistent with base
  `withRegistration` behaviour; documented in `useWishlistAuthDrawer`'s JSDoc
- **`ZimmWishlistAuthDrawer` is wired to `ProductTile` only.** Other wishlist entry points
  (PDP wishlist button, account wishlist page) are out of scope for this story
- **`--zimm-icon-container-md` foundation token** — referenced in `zimmFormInput` but not yet
  in `theme/foundation/sizes.ts`. Zero consumers exist today; the token gap will surface when
  SFCC-189 `sortOptions` resumes. Requires Tier 1 UI-designer approval to add
